summary.en: The Philippine Coast Guard rescued 22 people from a distressed boat off Palawan while the Philippine Air Force led a coastal cleanup on Panampangan Island in Tawi-Tawi, promoting sustainable tourism. A 28‑year-old man was killed and his younger brother was the attacker in a stabbing in Ozamiz City, and a driver was killed and a female passenger wounded in a gas-station shooting in BARMM’s SGA. Joint naval exercises involving the Philippines and France tested operational capabilities, and the Philippines and Japan added five new Coast Guard vessels to their maritime security cooperation. Finland and the Philippines signed a maritime security pact that includes Australian assistance for drones and cybersecurity. 176 battle-related deaths were reported in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Den filippinske kystvakten reddet 22 personer fra en nødstilt båt utenfor Palawan, mens den filippinske luftforsvaret ledet en kystopprydding på Panampangan-øya i Tawi-Tawi, for å fremme bærekraftig turisme. En 28‑år gammel mann ble drept og hans yngre bror var angriperen i et knivstikk i Ozamiz City, og en sjåfør ble drept og en kvinnelig passasjer såret i en skyting på en bensinstasjon i BARMMs SGA. Felles marineøvelser med deltakelse av Filippinene og Frankrike testet operasjonelle evner, og Filippinene og Japan la til fem nye kystvaktskip i sitt maritime sikkerhetssamarbeid. Finland og Filippinene signerte en maritim sikkerhetspakt som inkluderer australsk bistand for droner og cybersikkerhet. 176 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble rapportert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
